name: Zheng He's first treasure voyage departs
summary: The Yongle Emperor of Ming China dispatches admiral Zheng He with a fleet of 317 ships and 27,800 sailors on the first of seven 'treasure voyages' across the Indian Ocean. Subsequent expeditions reach the Persian Gulf and the East African coast as far as Malindi.

_quarry.structural_significance: Largest known maritime expeditions before the early modern era. Project the Ming as a tributary suzerain across the Indian Ocean but produce no permanent settlement. After Zheng He's final voyage (1433) the Ming retreat from oceanic projection; European exploration fills the void six decades later.
